Here, we have the product of two functions $u(x)={x}^{3}$ and $v(x)={e}^{x}.$ So, we apply the product rule:

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}^{′}(x) & =({x}^{3})^{′}{e}^{x}+{x}^{3}({e}^{x})^{′} \\  & =(3{x}^{2})({e}^{x})+({x}^{3})({e}^{x}) \\  & =3{x}^{2}{e}^{x}+{x}^{3}{e}^{x}\end{aligned}
$$
